title: Raytac MDBT50Q-1MV2 / MDBT50Q-P1MV2 approval sheet, Version L (2023-05-24)
supports: identity, order codes MD-240A3-007 (tray) / MD-240A3-007R (reel) (§4.3)
PCB size L 15.5 x W 10.5 (-0.15/+0.2) x H 2.05 mm, top/bottom/pin views (§2.1)
61 pads 0.6 x 0.4 mm, pad centre coordinates (§2.2 recommended solder pad layout, top view)
RF keep-out: no ground in any layer under the antenna, 3.8 mm antenna area; top-layer no-ground 1.6 x 1.2 mm at 2.95 mm (§2.3)
pin assignment table pins 1-61 with names, functions, standard-drive low-frequency pins (§2.5)
low-frequency I/O definition: up to 10 kHz; SPI, I2C, UART, PWM are not low frequency (§2.6)
32 MHz crystal and REG1 DC/DC inductor inside the module (§3, §8)
unit weight 0.68 g (+-0.02 g) for MDBT50Q-1MV2 (§4)
absolute maximum ratings and operating conditions copied from nRF52840 PS v1.7 (§5.1, §5.2)
power management sleep currents (§5.3.11)
reference circuits: normal voltage input on VDD+VDDH with DCCH unconnected (§8.3), VDDH supply above 3.6 V (§8.1, §8.2), USB powered (§8.4), USB disabled leave D+/D- NC (§8.5)
factory firmware: Raytac test code, LDO mode, needs external 32.768 kHz crystal (§8 notes)
features: BLE 5 / 802.15.4, -95 dBm (1 Mbps) and -103 dBm (125 kbps) sensitivity, +8 to -20 dBm TX, 1 MB flash / 256 kB RAM, 48 GPIO, supply 1.7-5.5 V (§1.2)
working distance over 550 / 300 / 150 m at 125 kbps / 1 / 2 Mbps; operating -40 to 85 C (cover page)

title: Nordic Semiconductor nRF52840 Product Specification v1.11 (4413_417, 2024-10-01), Digi-Key-hosted copy (docs.nordicsemi.com returned a Cloudflare challenge)
supports: normal voltage mode (supply on VDD and VDDH shorted) and high voltage mode (supply on VDDH only) (§5.3.1)
regulator operating conditions VDD 1.7/3.0/3.6 V, VDDH 2.5/3.7/5.5 V, VBUS 4.35/5/5.5 V, CVDD 2.7-5.5 uF (§5.3.8.1, §5.3.8.5)
REG0 output 1.8-3.3 V on VDD in high voltage mode; external draw 25 mA (<= 4 dBm TX), 5 mA (> 4 dBm), 1 mA in System OFF (§5.3.1.3, §5.3.8.2)
GPIO high level equals VDD (normal mode) or REGOUT0 (high voltage mode) (§5.3.1.2)
GPIO electrical specification: VIH 0.7 VDD, VIL 0.3 VDD, standard drive 2 mA typ, high drive 10 mA typ, pull resistors 13 kOhm (§6.9.3.1)
any pin can be mapped to a peripheral (§6.9 GPIO feature list)
SPIM up to 32 Mbps on SPIM3, SPIM0-2 not above 8 Mbps (§6.25); TWIM 100-400 kbps (§6.31); UARTE up to 1 Mbaud (§6.34)
sleep and radio currents: ION_RAMON_RTC 3.16 uA, ION_RAMON_GPIOTEPORT 2.36 uA, IRADIO_TX0 16.40 mA (+8 dBm), TX1 6.40 mA (0 dBm), RX0 6.26 mA (§5.2.1)
USB operating conditions VBUS 4.35-5.5 V (§5.3.8.5); USB active 2.4 mA from VBUS (§5.2.1.10); USBD is a full-speed device controller (§6.35)
LFXO load capacitance up to 12.5 pF (§5.4.2.4)
